questions.q: What did Judah offer his father so that Benjamin could go down to Egypt?
choices: To leave his own sons as hostages
To stand surety for the lad and bear the blame for ever
questions.explain: Of my hand shalt thou require him.

questions.q: Why did Jacob tell his sons to carry back the money found in their sacks?
choices: He would not keep what was not his; peradventure it was an oversight

questions.q: Why would the Egyptians not eat bread with the Hebrews?
choices: It was an abomination unto the Egyptians
questions.explain: The same thing showed up in America: colored only and whites only; they fashioned themselves after ancient Egypt.

questions.q: How much more was Benjamin's mess than his brothers'?
questions.explain: Joseph made sure his baby brother, his mother's son, was well taken care of.
